paragraphs.text: DeepSeek Harness plugin: upload, download, new folder, delete, drag-to-move and drag-to-chat for the
workspace Files tab
# Better Workspace File Manager
A file manager for the DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web **Files** tab and the file preview panel. It adds
the everyday file operations the shipped tree leaves out — upload, multi-select, download as a ZIP,
new folder, delete, drag-to-move, drag-to-chat, and in-place text editing — without modifying the sh
ipped Files tab's DOM.
## Features
### Files tab
- **Upload** by button, drag-and-drop from the computer, or a dropped folder (recreated recursively,

keeping both copies on a name clash).
- **Multi-select** with click, ⌘/Ctrl-click, Shift-click, or

a marquee drag over empty tree space.
- **Download** one file, several selected items, or a whole fo

lder as a ZIP. Archives are streamed, so large folders are not held in memory.
- **New folder** from

the right-click menu, with keep-both naming for folders created on your behalf.
- **Delete** files

and folders after a confirmation dialog. Directories are removed with everything inside them.
- **Dr
ag to move** rows onto a folder. A name already taken at the destination becomes `name (1).ext`, nev

er an overwrite.
- **Drag workspace rows into a conversation** to add `@path` chips, or image attach
ments for PNG/JPEG/WebP/GIF.
### File preview

- **Download** in the preview's opening menu, next to the shipped Open / Show location actions.
- **
Edit text files in place** for the text, code, and Markdown viewers. The editor keeps the file's lin
e endings (LF/CRLF) and byte-order mark, and saves through a version guard: if the agent or another

editor changed the file meanwhile, the save reports a conflict instead of overwriting it.
- **Save m
anually** with the Save button (or ⌘/Ctrl-S), or turn on **auto-save every 5 seconds** in Settings.
### Settings
The plugin contributes a **Text editing → Auto-save** row to the Plugins settings page. The choice i
s stored by the DSH Settings service, not in browser storage.
## Requirements

- DSH **Web** profile, version **0.2.1-rc.3 or newer**. Verified against:
- `0.2.1-rc.3`
- `0.2.1-rc

.5`
- `0.2.2-rc.1`
- A Host-local filesystem backend (`fs-local` / `fs-sandbox`), which is what Web

profiles mount.
- Node.js 20.15+ on the Host (the plugin uses the built-in Web Streams bridge; DSH i
tself may require a newer Node).
## Install
### From the DSH Plugins page
Open **Plugins** in the sidebar, find **Better Workspace File Manager**, and install or enable it. T
he page adds the package to the current profile and enables its bundle.

## Usage
### Selecting and acting on rows
| Gesture | Result |

| Click a row | Selects it, then opens or toggles the row as usual |
| ⌘/Ctrl-click | Adds or remove

s that row from the selection |
| Shift-click | Selects the range from the last anchor |
| Drag from

empty tree space, or Alt-drag anywhere | Draws a selection box |
| Right-click a row or empty tree

space | Opens the file menu |
| Drag rows onto a folder | Moves them there |
| Drag rows onto the co

mposer | Adds file/folder references or image attachments |
| Escape | Clears the selection, or canc
els an active box/drag |
## Compatibility notes
DSH 0.2.2 introduced a shared right-click menu (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-context-menu`) and shipp
ed file actions. The plugin detects that service at runtime:
- On **0.2.2+**, rows use the shared menu. The plugin contributes **Download as ZIP / Download N ite
ms**, **New folder**, and **Delete** to it. A single file's **Download** stays with the shipped file
-actions plugin, so there is no duplicate entry. The plugin's own overlay is still used for right-cl

icking empty tree space.
- On **0.2.1**, where the shared menu does not exist, the plugin keeps its
own right-click menu and all of its actions.
The integration is discovered through the `contextMenus` service; the plugin does not declare a hard
dependency on the 0.2.2-only client packages, so the same build loads on 0.2.1 and 0.2.2.
## How it works
- **Host half** (`index.js`) registers authenticated Connection Fetch routes under `/api/better-work
space-files`. Every path resolves through `ctx.fs.resolve` + `ctx.fs.contains`, so symlinks that lea
ve the workspace are refused. Moves and deletes act on the entry itself, not on what a symlink point

s at.
- **Browser half** (`client.js`) is one prebuilt client module. It reads the shipped Files tre
e through its stable `data-files-*` attributes and renders all of its own UI from its own slot entri

es. It never mutates the shipped tab's rows.
- **Downloads** are split into a validation step (`POST
selection` / `file-ticket`) that returns a short-lived ticket, then a plain `GET download?ticket` t
hat the browser's download manager can follow. ZIPs are produced by a streaming writer that uses dat

a descriptors and only emits ZIP64 fields when a size or offset needs them.
- **Text saves** go thro
ugh `ctx.fs.writeText` with `replaceIfVersion`, so they are atomic, keep the file's permissions, and
fail as `stale` instead of overwriting a concurrent change.
## Known limitations
- The Files tab exposes no selection, context-menu, or drag API. The plugin layers these on with win
dow-level event delegation keyed on the tab's `data-files-*` attributes. If a future DSH release ren

ames those attributes, the extras go inert and the shipped tab keeps working.
- Dragging workspace f
iles into a conversation reuses the composer's file intake. Image drops bypass the composer's pre-se
nd image count/size checks; the send then reports those limits as it does for any other oversized at

tachment.
- Byte I/O goes through `node:fs` on the Host's process path because the `fs` service has

no streaming byte read, binary write, rename, or removal. This assumes a Host-local backend.
- Text

editing loads files up to 32 MiB, matching the preview's complete-file read cap.
- The plugin does n
ot watch the workspace itself; it asks the Files tab to re-list through the tab's own reload control
after its own mutations.
